claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) argues measured mass, gravity, mathematics, and geometry support a spherical Earth and flat-Earth models lack cosmology.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the evidence is mathematical rather than photographic.

claims.assertion: Athena calls flat-Earth belief a manipulated agenda that may aim to discredit extraterrestrial claims.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She presents discrediting extraterrestrials as one possible motive.
